overview.text: DeskCrew presents a helpdesk combining tickets, live chat, a knowledge base and AI-assisted support. Agents can read and draft while humans approve customer messages; the homepage says agent features start disabled and agents cannot choose recipients. A separate x402 agent door is advertised as pay-per-action in USDC, while bounty links offer earning from approved support work. Paying for tool access and earning for support work are distinct.
